title: galactica.config.json
description: Overrides for Galactica. Every option is optional.

relativePath.description: A repository-relative path or glob: forward slashes, no leading / or ./, no drive letter, and no .. segment.

include.description: A module is kept when it matches one of these globs. Without include, every module is kept.

exclude.description: A module matching one of these globs is left out.

kinds.description: Globs for each module kind. A module they match takes that kind before the built-in rules. A module may match only one kind.

areas.description: Glob to the area path a matching module joins, inside the module's package. The first matching glob wins.

sourceUrl.description: Where html links source, with {commit}, {path} and {line}, or "none" to turn links off. --source-url wins over it.
